warnings: Every position prints a column-footing pair 'Cx-Fy' (column mark - footing mark). Recorded as two merged point elements per mark: the footing (F2 / F2A) and the column (C1-C4), each once with count + grid_refs (section 4 merge rule).

Only two footing marks appear on the plan: F2 (28 positions) and F2A (6 positions, row D under the C3 columns). The footing details (S-05, page 17: F2A, F2) were not extracted in this op04 run (shutdown deadline) - sizes/piles/rebar are not recorded here.
No columns at B1/B2/B5-B8/B11/B12 or C2/C5-C8/C11: the beams there (G11/B9 on S-02/S-03) run past those intersections without a column.
